hero.title: Tokutei Ginou (SSW) Program in Japan
hero.subheading: The Official Pathway to Professional Work in Japan with Specialized Skills

about.title: What is Tokutei Ginou?
about.desc: Tokutei Ginou (Specified Skilled Worker/SSW) is an official scheme by the Japanese government for foreign workers with specialized skills. This program opens legal employment opportunities across various industrial sectors with competitive salaries, clear contracts, and legal protection.
advantages: Official Tokutei Ginou (SSW) Work Visa issued by the Japanese Government.
Wide range of sectors: manufacturing, food, construction, hospitality, caregiving, and more.
Competitive salary equivalent to Japanese workers.
Clear employment contracts with legal protection.
Long-term career opportunities and visa extension.
about.noteDesc: Participants must pass Japanese language exams and skill tests according to their Tokutei Ginou field and be ready to adapt to Japanese work culture.

stages.title: Process to Become a Tokutei Ginou Worker

list.title: Selection & Administration
list.desc: Registration, initial screening, interviews, and processing of documents and training contracts in accordance with Tokutei Ginou standards.

list.title: Language & Skill Training
list.desc: Japanese language training up to at least N4 level and technical skill training based on the chosen sector.

list.title: Skill & Language Exams
list.desc: Taking Tokutei Ginou skill exams and Japanese language tests (JLPT/JFT-Basic) as employment requirements.

list.title: Placement & Departure
list.desc: Processing the Tokutei Ginou (SSW) visa and official job placement at a Japanese company according to the field.

cta.title: Work Legally in Japan through Tokutei Ginou
cta.desc: Structured training, a legal pathway, and real job opportunities across Japan’s industrial sectors.

KokoroGamae.title: KOKORO GAMAE
KokoroGamae.subtitle: Mental Attitude of Jisshusei
list: Obey the rules.
Work hard and give your best effort.
Observe, Listen, Think.
Take notes on important matters.
Greet others cheerfully and enthusiastically.
Answer honestly. Do not remain silent.
Be on time.
Work together.
Do not forget to say thank you.
If you do not understand, do not just say 'HAI', but ask. Do not remain silent. Do not decide by yourself.
When making a mistake, apologize immediately. Do not make excuses, practice self-reflection.
When making a mistake, do not smile or laugh.
Understand the mistake made, find the cause, and find ways to avoid repeating the same mistake.
Be careful and prioritize workplace safety.
Prepare before starting work. Tidy up after finishing work.
Work during working hours.
Look for work/tasks proactively.
Work quickly and accurately, then check your work.
Use tools as best as possible. If damaged or lost, report immediately.
If unable to attend, ask for permission in advance. When returning, apologize and report.
Maintain good health.
Maintain the cleanliness of yourself and your surroundings.
Change clothes every day. Always carry a handkerchief.
Keep hair, nails, mustache, and beard neatly trimmed.
Use a tissue to blow your nose. Do not spit on the street or in public places.
Clean up every day. Dispose of trash in its proper place.
No smoking.
To live independently in Japan, get used to doing laundry, cleaning your room, etc., by yourself.
Conserve water and electricity.
Do not be wasteful. Do not leave food scraps / finish your food.

instruktur.title: INSTRUCTOR RULES
rules: Instructors must arrive 10 minutes before the teaching and learning activities begin.
Instructors must adhere to the teaching code of ethics and the regulations applicable at the LPK.
Instructors shall prepare the necessary learning materials to ensure the smooth flow of the Teaching and Learning Activities (KBM).
Instructors are responsible for creating and preparing Lesson Plans (RPP), syllabi, and the learning curriculum.
Instructors must maintain and take care of office facilities, equipment, and the surrounding office area.
If an instructor is absent or needs to change the schedule, it must be coordinated with the administration department.
Instructors must dress neatly and professionally in accordance with LPK regulations.
Any ideas, input, criticism, or suggestions regarding LPK policies should be coordinated with the management.
Instructors must be available if students wish to consult on the material even after the class session has ended.
Instructors should act as motivators for both themselves and the students.
Other provisions will be communicated verbally.

asrama.title: DORMITORY RULES
rules: Students must arrive at the dormitory one day before teaching and learning activities begin.
Students are required to maintain dormitory facilities, furniture, and the area around the training dormitory.
Students must maintain order and cleanliness in and around the training dormitory.
Students are requested to conserve water and electricity.
Students must perform duty/toban according to the specified schedule. If a student is unable, they can swap with another student.
Smoking is prohibited inside the dormitory and the surrounding environment.
Students are not allowed to leave the dormitory past 10 PM without permission.
Male students are not allowed to visit the female dormitory, and vice versa.
If friends or relatives visit, please host them in the guest room.
Students are prohibited from having romantic relationships or 'cinlok' around the training dormitory.
Students are prohibited from bringing sharp weapons, drugs, or alcoholic beverages (miras) to the training dormitory area. Anyone found carrying them will be immediately dismissed.
Students are prohibited from performing immoral acts around the training dormitory area. Anyone found doing so will be immediately dismissed.
Students must dress neatly and politely around the training dormitory. Female students are requested to wear modest clothing and reasonable makeup.
Students must use polite language and not shout when speaking.
Students are requested not to bring vehicles/motorcycles. If one is brought, the LPK is not responsible for loss or damage.
Students who bring motorcycles must not speed around the dormitory.
Students must prioritize a culture of queuing for activities such as bathing, eating, etc.
Students must return and clean equipment after using it.
Students are requested to increase care for fellow friends and the environment.
Students are requested to cooperate, socialize, and help each other. Individualistic living is not permitted.
Students must report any problems to instructors or sensei.
LPK. AISHIRO GAKUEN reserves the right to unilaterally return or dishonorably discharge participants who violate the specified rules (undisciplined).
And other provisions that will be conveyed verbally.

asramaPutri.title: GIRLS' DORMITORY RULES
rules: Students must arrive at the dormitory one day before the teaching and learning activities begin.
Students must maintain and take care of dormitory facilities, furniture, and the surrounding dormitory area.
Students must maintain order and cleanliness around the training dormitory.
Students must perform duty (toban) according to the established schedule. If a student is unable to attend, they may swap with another student.
Smoking is prohibited inside the dormitory and the surrounding environment.
Students are not allowed to leave the dormitory without the instructor's permission.
Students are not allowed to stay out past 10 PM without permission.
Male students are not allowed to enter the female dormitory, and vice versa.
Students are not permitted to engage in romantic relationships within the dormitory area.
Possession of sharp weapons, drugs, and alcoholic beverages within the dormitory area is strictly prohibited.
Immoral acts within the dormitory area are strictly prohibited. Any student caught committing such acts will be immediately dismissed.
Students must dress neatly and appropriately around the dormitory area.
Students must use polite language and refrain from shouting when speaking.
Students using motorcycles are requested not to speed around the dormitory area.
Students must prioritize the culture of queuing for all activities, such as bathing, eating, etc.
Students must clean and return all equipment to its original place after use.
Students are expected to cooperate, socialize, and help each other. Individualistic lifestyles are not permitted.
Students must report any problems or issues to the instructor or sensei.
LPK. AISHIRO GAKUEN reserves the right to unilaterally dismiss or dishonorably discharge participants who violate the established rules (disciplinary action).
Other provisions will be communicated verbally.

siswa.title: STUDENT RULES
rules: Students must arrive 15 minutes before the teaching and learning activities begin.
Students must comply with all applicable regulations.
Students must maintain and take care of the building facilities, classroom equipment, and the area surrounding the training center.
Students must maintain order and cleanliness around the training center.
Eating and drinking are not allowed inside the classroom.
Smoking is prohibited in the classroom and the surrounding areas.
Students must collect/submit their mobile phones/smartphones during class sessions.
Students must participate in all training activities in an orderly manner according to the established schedule.
Students who cannot attend training due to illness must notify the instructor.
Students are not allowed to leave the training center without the instructor's permission.
Students must report any problems or issues to the instructor.
Possession of sharp weapons, drugs, and alcoholic beverages within the training center area is strictly prohibited.
Immoral acts within the training center area are strictly prohibited.
Students are requested not to bring vehicles/motorcycles. LPK. Aishiro Gakuen is not responsible for any loss or damage if a vehicle is brought.
Students must bring their own toiletries, cutlery, prayer equipment, and study materials. (Will be checked by the respective sensei).

Students must wear the designated uniform:
• Monday: White shirt, black trousers, and tie
• Tuesday: Sportswear and black trousers
• Wednesday: White shirt, black trousers, and tie
• Thursday: Casual clothes and black trousers
• Friday: White shirt, black trousers, and tie
• Saturday: Sports uniform
Female students are requested not to wear excessive jewelry except for earrings and rings, and to avoid excessive makeup.
Students must prioritize the culture of queuing during all activities (e.g., bathing, eating, etc.).
Students are requested to increase their care for fellow friends and the environment.
Students are expected to cooperate, socialize, and help each other. Individualistic lifestyles are not permitted.
LPK. AISHIRO GAKUEN reserves the right to unilaterally dismiss or dishonorably discharge participants who violate the established rules (disciplinary action).
Other provisions will be communicated verbally.
